---
title: Errors and limits
description: "Pi Durable Platform's error envelope, the status codes and error codes an app meets, rate limits and Retry-After, and how to retry safely."
---

## The envelope

Errors from `/v1` routes are JSON with an HTTP status:

```json
{"error": {"code": "thread_not_found", "message": "Thread not found"}}
```

Branch on `code`, not on `message`, which is for people and may change. Every response has an `X-Request-ID` header; log it.

The OAuth endpoints answer in OAuth's own format instead: `{"error": "invalid_grant", "error_description": "…"}`. See [OAuth endpoints](/docs/api/oauth-endpoints).

## Codes you'll meet

| Status | Codes | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `400` | `invalid_text`, `invalid_thread_id`, `invalid_visibility`, `invalid_title`, `invalid_name`, `invalid_external_key`, `invalid_group_by`, `invalid_range`, `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_query`, `invalid_idempotency_key`, `invalid_format`, `unsupported_version`, … | Fix the request |
| `400` | `invalid_kind`, `invalid_kind_settings` | A template version's [kind](/docs/teams/agent-kinds) or its settings aren't valid |
| `401` | `unauthorized` | The key or token is invalid, expired or revoked. For an OAuth token, refresh once, then reconnect ([OAuth Connect](/docs/build/oauth-connect#7-handle-a-refused-token)). |
| `403` | `forbidden`, `person_required` | The caller's role doesn't allow it, or a service account called a route about a person (or tried to move an agent) |
| | `insufficient_scope` | An app's token with scope `agents:read` tried anything but a read. Ask the person to connect it with `agents` |
| | `approval_forbidden` | The caller may see the [tool approval](/docs/teams/tool-approvals) but not decide it |
| `404` | `agent_not_found`, `thread_not_found`, `team_not_found`, `template_not_found`, `approval_not_found`, `trigger_not_found`, `run_not_found`, … | Doesn't exist, **or** the caller may not see it (another team's agent, another's private thread) |
| | `document_not_found` | The agent doesn't expose that document, or the thread doesn't have it ([Agent state for apps](/docs/build/agent-state)) |
| `409` | `visibility_fixed` | The thread's visibility was set when it started (by `POST …/threads`, its first message, or its MCP servers) and a request asked for another |
| | `agent_disabled` | The agent is turned off |
| | `agent_model_unavailable`, `model_unavailable` | The model isn't available to the team or workspace |
| | `name_taken` | Another agent in the team has this name |
| | `too_many_agents`, `limit_reached` | The team (50) or the personal workspace (`maxAgents`) is full |
| | `too_many_running` | A personal workspace is at `maxRunning`: close streams, or wait for an agent to hibernate |
| | `team_archived` | The team is archived and read-only |
| | `runtime_too_old` | The agent's data was written by a newer runtime than the one the platform would start: the operator must deploy a current runtime ([Building a custom agent](/docs/build/custom-agents#upgrades)) |
| | `approval_decided` | The approval was already decided, timed out or cancelled |
| | `agent_service_managed`, `move_template_unavailable`, `move_model_unavailable`, `move_same_team` | A move that can't be done: see [Moving an agent](/docs/use/moving-an-agent#what-the-target-must-offer) |
| `412` | `revision_conflict` | Someone changed it since you read it: read it again and retry |
| `422` | `idempotency_key_reused` | The `Idempotency-Key` was used for a different request: choose a new key ([Creating agents safely](/docs/build/creating-agents)) |
| | `document_too_large` | The document is larger than the bound the agent set for it |
| `428` | `revision_required` | Send `If-Match` with the revision |
| `429` | `rate_limited` | Wait `Retry-After` seconds |
| `502`, `503` | `agent_unavailable` | The agent couldn't be started, or didn't answer. Retry with backoff. |

## Rate limits

- **People**: `REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` (600 by default) per person per minute, one budget shared by their browser sessions, personal API keys and every app's tokens for them.
- **Service accounts**: the same number, per service account.
- **App secrets**: the same number, per secret.
- **OAuth endpoints**: 60 requests a minute per client address for authorize, token and revoke; 10 for registration (`429 slow_down`).
- **Sign-in**: `LOGIN_ATTEMPTS_PER_MINUTE` (20) per client address.
- **Webhook addresses**: 120 verified deliveries a minute per address, and 240 requests a minute per address and client address ([Webhooks](/docs/build/webhooks#rate-limits)).

Opening an event stream counts as one request, however long it stays open. Over a limit, the answer is `429` with `Retry-After` in seconds. The counters are kept in PostgreSQL.

## Retrying safely

- **Messages**: send a `requestId` with each message and reuse it when you retry; a repeated one isn't submitted twice.
- **Agents by key**: `PUT …/agents/by-key/{key}` is idempotent.
- **Creating agents with `POST`**: send an `Idempotency-Key` header and reuse it on retries; a retry returns the first agent with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. See [Creating agents safely](/docs/build/creating-agents).
- **Delta event streams**: reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`; every connection starts with a snapshot. See [Event streams](/docs/build/events#a-client-loop).
- **Event streams** end on platform restarts: reconnect with a short random delay.
- **`503`** while an agent wakes: back off and retry; waking takes seconds.

## Size limits

Messages: 32,000 characters. Thread IDs: 1 to 64 characters. Thread titles: 1 to 200. Agent names: 1 to 100; descriptions: 2,000. Template instructions: 20,000. Thread MCP servers: 10 per message.
